metric: Reuse evaluation/spacing.py without normalization. Count every sample, including unscoreable failures, and derive expected-space denominators from all frozen transcriptions independently of candidate output.
sample_protocol: Use the official publisher PDF only; record identity and provenance before sample selection.
Select approximately 30 single-line regions across the document, covering body text, headings, figure captions, table captions, references and mathematical symbols, with multiple font sizes/styles.
Transcribe from PDFium-rendered images before inspecting candidate-derived text. Use backend geometry only to locate complete glyphs, never as transcription ground truth.
Freeze coordinates, expected Unicode transcriptions, categories and verification status with SHA-256 before evaluating any candidate.
Label every agent transcription agent_visual_checked; do not invent human verification.
Keep non-space mismatches and unexpected line breaks explicit. Never change a frozen sample to improve a candidate score.
No new thresholds, parameter search, production parser edits or held-out-set changes.
